announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l9 — Relay diagnostics
announcements.summary: Concrete proxy, timeout, and Relay request diagnostics.
announcements.content:
This stable local build makes Relay and Manager network failures actionable.
1. Timeout errors show the target URL, timeout phase, effective direct/proxy route, and NO_PROXY match result.
2. Proxy credentials are redacted from diagnostics.
3. Relay-side failures return an error code and request ID for log lookup.
4. Health checks report whether the sharing Relay is configured.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l9 — Relay 诊断改进
zh.summary: 具体显示代理、超时和 Relay 请求诊断。
zh.content:
本稳定本地版本让 Relay 与 Manager 的网络故障更容易定位。
1. 超时错误显示目标 URL、超时阶段、实际直连/代理路径和 NO_PROXY 匹配结果。
2. 诊断信息会脱敏代理凭据。
3. Relay 侧处理失败时返回错误码和 requestId，便于查询日志。
4. 健康检查报告共享 Relay 是否已配置。
